### [S019.U2] PART 2 - PRODUCTS > 2.3 GRADES OF CONCRETE > TABLE -- 4 / CONCRETE GRADES AND CHARACTERISTIC COMPRESSIVE STRENGTHS
- NOTE - 1 In the designation of a concrete of mix, letter M refers to the mix and the number to the specified characteristic compressive strength of 15 cm cube at 28 days, expressed in N/mm 2 .
- NOTE - 2 M 5 and M 7.5 grade of concrete may be used for lean concrete bases and simple foundations for masonry walls. These mixes need not be designed.
- NOTE - 3 Grades of concrete lower than M 15 shall not be used in reinforced concrete.

### [S049.U2] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.6 CONCRETE
- B. Cement Concrete.
1. This shall be classified as plain cement concrete or reinforced cement concrete. Plain cement concrete shall be used in leveling courses under foundations, floors, copings etc. Reinforced cement concrete shall be used typically at all locations.
- a. Concrete shall be classified by its compressive strength at the 28th day. The concrete grades shall be as designated in table 2 of IS 456 and are given as ready reference in Table - 4.

### [S049.U4] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.6 CONCRETE > B. Cement Concrete.
- c. The Contractor shall ensure that the minimum cement content per cubic

- meter of reinforced concrete should not be less than that stipulated in table 23, 24, 25 and 26 of SP 23 and Table 5 and Table 6 herein.
- d. For expected strength of cubes tested on the 28 th day the design mix at preliminary test and work site shall be as per IS 456, SP 23 and SP 24. The water cement ratio shall be between 0.5 to 0.52. Additional water may be permitted only at the discretion of the ER. The slump shall be 25 mm to 35 mm depending upon the location and type of Work. Higher slump with use of plasticizers shall be permitted.

### [S049.U7] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.6 CONCRETE > C. Design Mix And Trial Mixes
4. Trial mixes shall be approved provided that average strength of 3 consecutive cubes is not less than that specified and that one out of three may give a value less than specified but limited to a maximum of 90% of the specified strength.
5. In case the trial mix falls below the above criteria, the ER shall order fresh trial mixes to be made as before, until the desired strength is arrived at.

### [S053.U2] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.6 CONCRETE > H. Construction joints > 1. In large pours, it is practically not possible to carry on concr...
2. Form construction joints with a shear key. In walls, do not space construction joints more than 18m apart in horizontal direction, maximum 6m apart in vertical direction

- unless otherwise shown. In framed slabs and beams, and on metal deck slabs, do not space construction joints more than 27m apart. In slabs on grade, do not space construction joints more than maximum 18m in any direction. Place construction joints perpendicular to main reinforcement. Continue reinforcement across construction joints except as otherwise shown.

### [S059.U1] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.9 FIELD QUALITY CONTROL > 7. Acceptance of Work > a. This shall be as given in IS 456, SP 23 and SP 24. Part or eleme...
- a. This shall be as given in IS 456, SP 23 and SP 24. Part or element of Work shall be deemed to be accepted, provided the results of the 28 th day cube testing conform to the criteria stated as under
- 1) The average of the three consecutive cube's strength shall not be less than the specified strength.

### [S059.U2] PART 3 - EXECUTION > 3.9 FIELD QUALITY CONTROL > 7. Acceptance of Work > a. This shall be as given in IS 456, SP 23 and SP 24. Part or eleme...
- 2) No individual cube strength shall be less than 90% of the specified strength.
- 3) If an individual cube strength is more than 33% below the specified strength, such a cube shall be classified as a freak and the criteria in (a) and (b) shall be applied to the remaining two cubes and their acceptability determined.

- d. Acceptance of Work
